source: niche_scan.py v2, 20 results per query phrase, channel data cached

niches.label: Contractor estimating
niches.supply: no dataset, but the arithmetic is simple and re-derivable
niches.verdict: Worth testing, score 5.70 of 10. The median video in the top 39 results has 15,032 views; 86% of those views go to channels under 150,000 subscribers, and 97% of the channels are that small. The top three channels take 56% of the views, and the median incumbent has published 444 videos. Content supply scores 6/10 (uncapped); policy risk is low.
niches.call: The best door in the set. Trades content is made by tradespeople with cameras, not by studios -- but the wall is ours, not the market's: no estimating dataset on the shelf yet, so weekly output starts with building one.
niches.action: Post one estimating rule per week, filmed as a screen recording of the sheet. Kill line: five posts, none past 1,000 views.

niches.label: Commercial real estate math
niches.policy_note: Finance education. No persona, arithmetic only, never a recommendation.
niches.supply: 72 deterministic calculators + the deal book already built
niches.verdict: Worth testing, score 5.52 of 10. The median video in the top 35 results has 9,421 views; 86% of those views go to channels under 150,000 subscribers, and 86% of the channels are that small. The top three channels take 58% of the views, and the median incumbent has published 479 videos. Content supply scores 7/10 (capped at policy_risk=medium caps 10 -> 7 by policy); policy risk is medium.
niches.call: The only niche where the supply already exists. Every reel transcribes from a calculator we ship, and the door is as open as the trades. Policy is the one tax on it, and a cited number is how you pay it.
niches.action: One calculator per reel, narrated over the actual number. This is the channel the existing engine already feeds.

niches.label: Medical billing / coding
niches.policy_note: Healthcare claims; adjacent to medical advice rules even when purely administrative.
niches.verdict: Thin, score 3.92 of 10. The median video in the top 39 results has 28,066 views; 45% of those views go to channels under 150,000 subscribers, and 67% of the channels are that small. The top three channels take 66% of the views, and the median incumbent has published 594 videos. Content supply scores 4/10 (uncapped); policy risk is high.
niches.call: A specialist niche with real numbers and moderate openness, held back by policy: billing advice is regulated, and a wrong post is a liability rather than a bad video.
niches.action: Only with a compliance reviewer. Otherwise the policy cap is doing you a favour.
